summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed display in rich/progress.py: track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a documented class docstring, a static render_speed(speed) that uses filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render branch for unknown totals using finished_speed or speed; Progress.track now infers an Optional total instead of raising for unsized iterables. Added the CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line. In tests/test_progress.py, removed the two ValueError assertions and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions; those checks are unverified.
